name: Bee and Cairn: Rippily traffic ingest

nodes.name: Rippily traffic in
nodes.notes: Header Auth credential must use header name X-Bee-Cairn-Token and the value of RIPPILY_FORWARD_TOKEN. Responds 200 immediately so a slow sheet write never counts as a failed delivery.

nodes.name: Strip identity and pair sessions
nodes.notes: Drops name, tagname and email. Deduplicates retries. Pairs each leave with its join to produce a session duration.

nodes.name: Append to traffic sheet
nodes.notes: Select your Google Sheets credential, spreadsheet and tab after import. Header row must be: type, recordedAt, occurredAt, action, participantId, role, rippleId, rippleName, waveName, durationSeconds, verified, detail
